styleSelection.reason: Requested urban sketch, pen plus light wash: the pen carries roofs, wall edges, windows, cypress contours and the pine's trunk and branches; pale flat washes with white paper kept in the lit stone and path, one shadow glaze for the foliage darks.

families.referenceCue: Terracotta hip roofs, ochre and mauve-grey stone walls: flat pale planes, lit faces kept light, one connected shadow glaze across the wall faces; pen carries eaves, corners and windows.
Small stone houses stepping up the hill between dark cypress and olive: mauve wall, orange roof, pale ochre faces; kept small and dry.
Ochre sunlit path and terrace wall, pale and warm with paper showing; tall dark cypress columns standing on it.
Dark grey-green olive and oak masses against paler lime tops; connected shapes, one dark glaze.
Large pale yellow-green pine canopy with sparkling light gaps; dark trunk and rising branches drawn in pen.
Grey-green olive trees with thin dark trunks over tan ground.
Mid green olive tops, dark undersides, tan ground showing between.
Distant blue-green hills, pale and soft.
